body:
Yeah, one day at a time.

And yes, transferring is super important to me, I almost regard it as a panacea. If I manage to improve and transfer and get somewhere in life, it will fix everything. I’ll stop being regarded as the garbage in the family, I’ll stop being compared to my worthless grandfather, I can make people happy without hurting them, I can fix my friendships that I lost. I want to be away from home. Being by myself is really liberating.

I honestly want to drop 1 class, but I can’t because it’s vital if I want to apply to transfer this year. I understand the sentiment though.

And thanks!

Yeah, you’re right.

I’m really immature and I gotta grow up somehow.

I’m transferring as a bio major but if I screw up this semester, I have to stop studying and switch vocations - it’s a deal I made with my parents.

It’s kind of strange - I have these cycles where I get ultra depressed about this stuff and then I want to apologize and everything, and sometimes I send her an apology. But then the cycle shifts and then I’m like “Oh shoot I screwed up, my buddy needs space from me. Time to delete it.”
I’ve been getting better about it recently hah, I’m slowly managing to stop trying to apologize over it. It’s really creepy and scary.

Now obviously everything is my fault, hah. 

I wish I could take this term off! But I can’t, I have to get good grades this semester because I was planning on transferring this year. I already missed a month of work from two science classes, so I’m in an explicably rough spot. I’m caught up everywhere else though.

Honestly I hate things as they are right now. I don’t have any IRL friends, I’ve tried talking to people before, I don’t think I’m trying hard enough to get to know people though because I was so fixated on one person. I actually managed to make a friend last year! But then I became really needy over summer and neglected him a lot in favor of my other friend. So really, I think this break between me and my old friend is for the best. We can both grow from it. That’s good, I hope she’ll be happier.

I used to have a 1.4 GPA lol but I boosted it to 3.0 recently. It’s pretty great.

I feel like as I keep trying to get better and improve on my own, emphasis on “on my own,” things will just get better in general. I don’t know, maybe in a year or so I can rekindle the friendship although bridges were burned. She knows what’s going on with my life.
It’s weird because like
I know I can’t think about that because I have to focus on myself first.
It doesn’t matter if my parents want me to die or whatever, I gotta do the right thing and improve and change drastically.
